description: Price a catalog item with the customer's values (e.g. slug "personalized-name-ornament", values {"name": "Leo", "line2": "2026"}). Omitted parameters keep their defaults. We render the part from its parametric source and slice it; returns quote_id, size, grams, price delivered by USPS Ground Advantage and an order_url. Then use price_quote or create_checkout with that quote_id, like any quote.

values.description: Parameter values by key (from list_catalog). Text up to the listed length; numbers within min and max.

name: quote_catalog_item
title: Quote a customized catalog part
